identificationModule.briefTitle: TL938 and Trastuzumab for Patients With HER2-positive Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2 Study to Evaluate TL938 Combined With Trastuzumab in Patients With HER2-positive Metastatic Colorectal Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a Phase II trial designed to determine the optimal dose and evaluate the effectiveness of TL938 and trastuzumab in treating patients with HER2+ colorectal cancer that has metastasized or recurred and is inoperable.

armGroups.label: TL938-Trastuzumab combination
armGroups.description: TL938-Trastuzumab combination receives TL938 capsules by mouth once daily. Trastuzumab given intravenously on Day 1 of each Cycle. Cycle length is 21 days

armGroups.label: TL938
armGroups.description: TL938 monotherapy receives TL938 capsules by mouth once daily. Cycle length is 21 days.
